subject: STOP statement
notes: Train-1031 lander review (kb/Work PB397): the rule governs STOP RUN, the only STOP of 14.9.42. The X3.23-1985 STOP literal (deleted 2002) communicates to the operator and continues with the next statement, so a statement after it executes and it is not refused (it was, at 85, before this correction); StopLiteral_FollowedByAStatement_IsAccepted and the 85 golden's AFTER-STOP-LITERAL line pin it. kb/Work PB2610: 'a discreet block of code' is read (docs/CONFORMANCE.md D-SEQ) as 14.9.17.3 SR2's consecutive sequence of imperative statements, so a following CONDITIONAL statement ends it as it ends SR2's: STOP RUN before an IF with no END-IF is accepted (Stop_LastInItsBlock_IsAccepted SQS04, the 85 golden pb2610_go_to_before_conditional P-STOP), STOP RUN before a delimited EVALUATE is refused (SQS14). retired-witness: conformance-test:StatementSequencePlacementTests.StopLiteral_FollowedByAStatement_IsRefused (renamed StopLiteral_FollowedByAStatement_IsAccepted by the train-1031 review: the 1985 STOP literal continues with the next statement, so SR1 does not govern it)
